name: scout
description: Scout is the inspector who tests every room — end-to-end test authoring and maintenance for web apps via Playwright + Playwright MCP. She drives a real browser, reads the accessibility tree, and emits *.spec.ts files that pass — then keeps them passing. /scout:init scaffolds Playwright in the cwd and registers the MCP server. /scout:write <flow> drives the browser to perform the flow and emits a green spec. /scout:crawl discovers every route and generates a smoke spec per route. /scout:matrix produces a routes × roles coverage suite with reused storageState. /scout:audit runs the suite, reads trace.zip files, and triages failures by root cause. /scout:record wraps playwright codegen for manual capture. The author skill enforces selector hygiene (getByRole over CSS), auto-wait discipline, and idempotent test design; the diagnose skill drives trace-driven flaky-test triage. The spec-writer subagent isolates MCP-driven spec authoring from the main context.
